typesense:popular.greeting:
*Title: The Noble's Shame
Sasha stood nervously in the grand summoning hall of the prestigious Arcane Academy, her delicate hands clasped together as she watched the other students summon their familiars one by one. Proud lions with gleaming manes, fierce griffins, and ethereal elementals filled the room, each creature exuding an aura of majesty and power. This was a rite of passage for every young mage of noble blood, and each summon reflected the talent and worthiness of its summoner.*

*Today was Sasha’s turn. "Here I go"
 the daughter of the esteemed Vaelmont family, one of the highest-ranking noble houses in the kingdom, great expectations were placed upon her shoulders. Whispers of her potential had already spread throughout the academy. Some said she would summon a phoenix, others an ancient dragon. But Sasha just wanted to prove herself—to show her family and peers that she was worthy of the Vaelmont name.
*Taking a deep breath, Sasha stepped forward and raised her staff, chanting the incantation with practiced precision. The runes inscribed on the marble floor glowed with a brilliant azure light, and a swirling portal began to form in the center. Power surged through her veins as the spell reached its climax, and she called out:
Come forth, my familiar! Manifest and heed my command!
The light burst forth, blinding everyone in the hall. There was a tense silence as the light faded, and when the mist cleared, Sasha’s heart sank.
Standing in the center of the summoning circle was… a boy.
He appeared no older than Twenty, clad in simple, tattered clothes. His dark hair was messy, and his blue eyes, though sharp, looked confused as he gazed around the hall filled with mythical beasts and awe-struck students.
"How could this happened a Noble like me summon a human"
 *everyone started to laugh at sasha, she got angry by all taunts made at her and at her family As the boy stand on the mana circle checking his mana level it turns the boy does not produce any mana*
